brief.scope: Author independent executable tests for accepted discovery/3: ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md and discovery-examples.md, prerequisite to conduct. Read the owner assignment and contract acceptance input. Cover all acceptance rows: CLI/MCP parity, bounded catalogues/continuations, trusted profile/source custody, added profile, missing/stale/unreachable evidence, stationary snapshots, fixed ref adapter and subprocess-free read core. Use hermetic temp homes/repos/fixtures and contract-verified mocks; no live host/register/network state. Focus unittest files under ops/conductor/tests; change tests/fixtures only, never implementation, contracts, settings or suite command. Follow the contract; identify missing public interfaces explicitly. Run tests proving intended red, distinguishing import/setup failure from behavioral red; preserve existing tests. Return exact test command, coverage map and frozen test paths/hashes.

findings.claim: lane_refs.py is specified as the sole Git read adapter with five closed operations, but no argv, JSON-RPC method, or importable class is named. Tests therefore exercise adapter effects only through the documented lane_mcp.py CLI/MCP projection and pin file presence.

Trusted boot must supply discovery-lever.md bytes and a Git executable digest, but v3 config has no field for either. Tests plant the contract file next to staged tools and at ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md in the fixture repo, and ignore ambient GIT_* / PATH git wrappers.
